For z in J_c, the vertices of its old maximal parent face all belong to J_c. Thus F_z lies in conv(J_c), and the supporting equations of F_z make it a face of conv(J_c) since this smaller hull lies in Q. The point z remains in relint(F_z). The maximal minimal faces of the component hull are therefore exactly the original maximal faces in component c.
